phrases.latin: Theodōrus autem nōn ībat sed currēbat
phrases.english: Theo, though, wasn’t walking but running

phrases.latin: ad olīvam tolūtim cucurrit truncumque manū tangēns «Valē, olīva!» inquit
phrases.english: he trotted over to the olive tree and, touching the trunk, said, “Goodbye, olive tree!”
phrases.source: Libellus V, Lisbōna: castellum et ōceanārium
